tests.command:
/usr/bin/python3 -B scripts/lint-frontmatter.py .
bash -c '/usr/bin/python3 -B -c "import json;[json.loads(l) for l in open(\"tests/fixtures/jev-t3-corpus.jsonl\") if l.strip()]" && echo corpus-ok'
bash -c 'for s in scripts/compound-v-*.py; do grep -q -- "--selftest" "$s" || continue; /usr/bin/python3 -B "$s" --selftest >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $s"; exit 1; }; done; for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done; echo all-tests-ok'
failures: bash -c 'for s in scripts/compound-v-*.py; do grep -q -- "--selftest" "$s" || continue; /usr/bin/python3 -B "$s" --selftest >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $s"; exit 1; }; done; for t in tests/*.sh; do bash "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done; echo all-tests-ok'
